independence.agreement: every reported quantity equals the Engine's claim: membership, classes, exclusions, retained detections, both matchings, both losses and the weighted delta
independence.boundary_sensitivity: the closest excluded annotation sits at 50.28 metres against a 50 metre boundary, a margin of 0.28 metres. The membership is not far from the boundary and a different declared range would change it
independence.cross_check: the ego translation this lane recovered from the original table, [1246.1489, 1090.7646], equals the nominal ego XY the common operands carry, which were produced by a different lane at a different time
independence.scope: a reconstruction of the Engine's computation from the original tables. It establishes that the number is what the declared rules give on the declared bytes. It establishes nothing about whether the annotation is correct
independence.suppression_rule_recovered: same class, strictly within 2 metres, against the retained base and against previously retained candidates. Base only gives 10 additions at window-0001 instead of 9; adding candidate against candidate gives exactly 9 and 7
what_was_not_rebuilt: the upstream detector inference, which was never rerun by anyone
the score threshold and the operand qualification, which are consumed from the common operands
the annotation itself, which is the benchmark's and is the thing under question
what_was_rebuilt_here: the 119 annotations at the two anchors, from the original sample_annotation table
their categories, through the original instance and category tables
the ego pose, from the original sample_data and ego_pose tables, by a targeted byte scan
the ego relative range of every annotation, by this lane's own quaternion transform
the range filter, which accounts for all 13 exclusions and no category is unmapped
the retained base detections and the suppression rule that produces the additions
both maximum matchings, by this lane's own matcher
